english.title: Fail to attend / remain for initial assessment following test for presence of Class A drug - Drugs Act 2005
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a sample having been taken from you under section 63B of the Police and Criminal Evidence Act 1984 and analysis of that sample revealed that a Class A drug, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DRUG..), may be present in your body, you failed to

(A)_[attend]_
(B)_[remain for the duration of]_

an initial assessment to establish whether you were dependant upon or had a propensity to misuse a Class A drug
english.legislation: Contrary to section 12(3) and (4) of the Drugs Act 2005.

Summary: Fifty one weeks imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note:
In relation to an offence committed before the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003, the reference to fifty one weeks is to be read as a reference to three months
